study_design: Pooled analysis of 15 prospective cohort studies
cohort_total_n_excerpt: a pooled analysis of 15 prospective cohorts, including 52,680 total cases and 3,205 prostate cancer-related deaths among 842,149 men.
reason: The prospective pooled-cohort analysis examined prostate cancer risk overall and explicitly analyzed advanced prostate cancer. Prostate cancer mortality was also studied but is not itself an incident endpoint.
